sounds.prompt: One deep underwater explosion heard entirely from below the water surface. A rounded powerful sub bass pressure thump, heavily muffled dark rumbling and a brief dense bubble collapse. Very little treble. Short natural decay into silence. Isolated underwater sound, no surface splash, no metallic crack, no music.

A single muffled torpedo detonation deep below the sea. A heavy low frequency pressure pulse followed by a compact hollow underwater rumble and faint dark bubbles. Thick and submerged, not a cannon shot. One isolated impact then silence, no bright splash or voices.

One submerged explosion with a deep dull boom and collapsing underwater bubbles. Soft rounded attack with weight in the bass, a low hollow reverberation quickly fading away. Recorded underwater, dark low pass sound. No surface spray, high crack, music or speech.

Extremely gentle small water ripples moving slowly back and forth, heard close to the water in a quiet sheltered pool. Soft smooth liquid movement at constant low intensity, delicate rounded lapping. Only water texture throughout. No wildlife, birds, chirps, people, wind, crashing waves or music.

A continuous very soft wash of calm water, smooth little swells gently rising and receding. Quiet intimate liquid ambience with subdued high frequencies and no foreground events. Even soothing texture, not ocean surf. Water only, no birds, animals, voices, wind or music.

Continuous delicate tiny wavelets quietly touching still water. Slow gentle motion, silky soft low intensity water wash, rounded and muffled droplets. Peaceful steady background water with no sharp events. No birds, chirping, wildlife, wind, large waves, speech or music.
